items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: And Bill Russell gathered you and I think Ida and I followed along with you.

ctx.x: We've talked so much about the brass bands. Tell me about going to here in my hair, Joe. Oh, okay.

Yeah. You did want to make sure. Well, again, I don't remember exactly what year that was. It was, my guess is it was 58, but it might have been 57. But I remember that I first became aware of it when riding on the Fred Street bus and seeing notices on telephone poles and in record shops, placards, that she was going to be here. And so I, you know, we might have not talked about it. We certainly would like to go and hear her do that. And so we made our plans to do so. She was going to sing on a Sunday, I believe,…
